reading.body:
Expedient operates four data centers totaling 10.6 MW of critical IT load across Maryland, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin, with the largest facility in Pittsburgh at 1.8 MW.

The company traces to the October 2003 acquisition of Stargate Business, a Pittsburgh-based operator, and designated Pittsburgh as its headquarters in May 2004. Its workforce and infrastructure were already concentrated there, establishing the footprint from which it has since expanded into adjacent regional markets. Expedient was privately held through the mid-2000s under the Continental Broadband family, owned by Landmark Communications, before Australian investment firm AMP Capital became its investment sponsor in a later transaction.

The registry tracks only three facilities across two states because Expedient's current locations page is not accessible. The data covers two facilities in the Baltimore market—Owings Mills and Tidepoint—with combined capacity of 3.8 MW across 45,000 square feet, plus Pittsburgh South at 1.8 MW in 26,000 square feet and Milwaukee at 1.6 MW in 27,000 square feet. All facilities report 2N or better UPS configurations and multiple carrier connections, indicating they serve enterprise and cloud customers requiring redundancy. This does not capture the full operator portfolio or current growth trajectory.
